reviewItem.question: Does "The `cilium-dbg status --verbose` command health data may now show health reported on a non-leaf component under a leaf named `reporter`. Health data tree…" mean a change to cli-flag:cilium|name=--verbose|component=cilium-dbg (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: The cilium-dbg status --verbose command output format changed: health data from non-leaf components now appears under a reporter leaf, and health data tree branches are now sorted by fully qualified health status identifier.
